Prevention: Crop rotation and /or intercrop cabbage with mustard at every 15 rows of cabbage as a trap crop.
Field sanitation – remove weeds which can be host plants.
Conserve natural enemies like, spiders, parasitic wasps, praying mantis, ants, and birds.
Monitoring: Regular monitoring - check the crop twice weekly in order to detect the caterpillars before they move towards the growing centre of the plant.
Monitor damage by counting damaged cabbage head.
Direct Control: Use botanical pesticide (e.g. fresh neem, lemongrass, ginger) 1 litre/15 litres of water.
